New machine-readable checks and a front-of-report decision index independently address enforcement and observability, without touching guest screen geometry or repeating any failed Dynamic Island fix.

Add dedicated tests with deliberate failed Safe Area and renamed-code examples. Add remediationDecisionIndex() to HostApp DiagnosticRecorder and render a compact recent 18-entry decision ledger before JSONL; retain full immutable historical JSON and handoff prompt after JSONL. Update bundled AI handoff instructions with mandatory pre-edit CLI usage and latest SDK override evidence. Add explicit no-repeat CI command before native integration, correct regex literal escaping, allow anonymous elapsed_ms through recorder, guard elapsed_ms via static test, normalize related guest_boot/guest_top/rotation_top problems and reject no-diff proposals.

before: # Scarlet Crystal — 로그 한 개로 이어서 수정하는 AI 전용 지침 (R6P10)
after: # Scarlet Crystal — 로그 한 개로 이어서 수정하는 AI 전용 지침 (R6P13)
이 보고서는 단순 런타임 로그가 아니라 다음 코드 변경을 결정하는 **보존된 실패 실험 기록**이다.
- 보고서 앞부분 \`NO-REPEAT DECISION INDEX\`는 최근 수정 ID/버전/원인 메커니즘/상태/코드 파일을 먼저 보여준다. 전체 변경 전후 원본 코드와 커밋은 뒤의 \`REMEDIATION HISTORY\`에 보존된다. 앞부분만 보고 이전 이력이 없다고 판단하지 않는다.
- 수정 **전에** 후보 작업을 JSON으로 작성해 \`python3 rebuild/diagnostics/scarlet_no_repeat_gate.py --proposal proposal.json\`을 실행한다. 실패하면 코드 수정을 시작하지 않는다.

- \`novelty.prior_excluded_ids\`, \`novelty.causal_difference\`, \`novelty.falsifiable_prediction\`은 필수다. 동일 실패 원인을 다시 사용할 경우 실제 기기에서 얻은 \`source_commit/event/observed_value\`와 이전 방식이 실패한 구체적 이유까지 제출해야 한다.
- 소스의 변경 전후가 기존 이력과 실질적으로 같은 경우, 메커니즘 이름이나 버전만 바꿔도 \`NO-REPEAT-BLOCK\`으로 거부한다. 빈 전후 코드·diff hunk가 없는 새 조치도 거부한다.
- CI 테스트가 같은 검증 함수를 호출하여 **빌드 시작 전** 이력을 검사한다. 프로그램이 인과관계의 모든 동의어를 자동 이해한다고 가정하지 않는다. 의미적으로 유사한 조치는 앞의 \`재시도 판별 키\`에 따라 추가로 수동/AI 검토해야 한다.
- 새 작업이 성공하지 못한 경우에도 실패 사실과 수정 코드 범위를 \`Lxxx\`에 남긴다. 새 로그를 받으면 이전 실패 메커니즘은 자동 제외 후보이며, 성공으로 바꾸려면 별도 실기기 시각·터치 증거가 필요하다.

source_revisions.title: fix(r6p14): collapse switcher before guest selection and home exit
fix(r6p14): reset retained panel lifecycle on home, activate and enqueue
test(r6p14): prevent expanded panel carryover on guest navigation
fix(r6p14): immediate navigation close without morph
fix(r6p14): request immediate close during resident scene navigation
test(r6p14): immediate close and V25 compatibility
ci(r6p14): unique unsigned release and build branch

novelty.causal_difference: L047 targeted delayed mount/opacity of recent rows; R6P14 targets the independent navigation state machine where the host hides a retained UIWindow while @State isOpen remains expanded or close happens after onSwitch. It closes before navigation, not by waiting for a render/mount tick.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: In an installed R6P14 iPhone report, tapping B or leaving A for Home emits switch_panel_dismissed or switch_panel_navigation_reset before the next guest activation / fullscreen_scene_home; reopening B shows the collapsed round button first, then current A/B rows on tap.

new_device_evidence.observed_value: count 2 at 02:50:27.044 vs first later explicit dismiss at 02:50:34.391 UTC

novelty.why_prior_fix_failed: L047 eagerly mounted recent app rows but did not modify the switchTo/onExit ordering or retained SceneStack UIWindow visibility transitions.

entries.repeat_policy: If R6P14 still expands after navigation, inspect ordering of switch_panel_navigation_reset, switch_panel_dismissed and resulting rendered state; do not reapply the same lifecycle calls or repeat L047 row-mount edits.
entries.success_gate: Source gate and all 491 static tests pass, Xcode 27.2 build yields unique unsigned R6P14 IPA and nonoverwritten prior releases; on iPhone A expanded -> B selected and A expanded -> Home -> B launched both immediately restore collapsed button; new panel opens with A/B rows first frame and no fullscreen size/orientation regression. Inspect switch_panel_navigation_close_applied receipt on device, not only switch_panel_navigation_reset request.
entries.privacy: Anonymous transition reasons and counts only; no guest names or identifiers exported.

entries.hypothesis: R6P13 iPhone report showed 62pt normal host window and remote hosting-owner top yet visual island collision continued. Host FBScene metrics do not establish the UIKit safe-area inset consumed by the guest app own root VC, launched inside LiveProcess after host UI initialization. Test the root only after a real guest UIWindow becomes visible or key; never hook all UIKit methods.
entries.action: Preserve R6P14 switcher/navigation behavior and display scale. Publish anonymous normal UIWindow portrait safe-top in LC App Group only when 20..130pt; inject separate opt-in LiveProcess tweak with UIKit UIWindow lifecycle notification observers (not global swizzling). Compare the guest root UIView.safeAreaInsets.top to max of guest statusBarFrame and verified host top; set only the missing delta via UIViewController.additionalSafeAreaInsets after the guest root has a window. Skip landscape, wrong/not-attached windows, already safe roots, bad/missing target and non-resident processes. Publish PID-scoped anonymous root before/after receipts back to host logs. Add five source/generator tests and independent R6P15 unsigned IPA branch. Pre-build safety hardening: wait for two bounded UIKit layout samples before first correction; associate one owned extra-top delta per guest root to prohibit double padding on UIWindow visible+key notifications. If system safe top resolves later, trim only our additional excess, without altering any app-added original insets.
entries.observation: Only prior iPhone SourceCommit e6afe296a535 is observed: normal UIWindow safeTop=62, temporary host viewport top 0, remote owner readback=62, yet guest top bars were reported obscured. New guest-root before/after values have not yet been measured on a real iPhone. 496 local Python regression tests, generator test, YAML parser and git diff --check passed. Native Xcode integration, iPhone optical and touch proof pending. Follow-up guest root race hardening and extended 496/496 source suite pass; these are source verifications, not iPhone visual success. Xcode 27.2 LiveContainer native-engine build succeeded in workflow run 43150404935. iPhone visual correction is still unverified.
evidence: 2026-11-12 iPhone report session 7b3e207c: safearea 62->0->62 and owner -1->62 for two guest launches.
User reports Instagram and potentially other guest apps with island-obscured top controls despite previous 62pt host readbacks.
Original Apple UIKit additionalSafeAreaInsets public root container contract; window-root attachment is required before reading safeAreaInsets.
All exact source hunks captured under code_locations; opt-in bit precedes LiveProcess bootstrap.

before: // R6P11: anonymous guest Mach-O SDK contract, no identifier/path.
after: // R6P11: anonymous guest Mach-O SDK contract, no identifier/path.
// Guest-owned UIKit readback only; no names, screenshots or bundle IDs.

before: // Keep prior scene visible until this exact remote process reports
// readiness; never flash an uninitialized black child scene.
after: // Keep prior scene visible until this exact remote process reports
// readiness; never flash an uninitialized black child scene.
// R6P15: guest-only safe-area correction evidence. The guest writes an
// anonymous bounded readback into the existing LC App Group and posts a
// PID-scoped Darwin notification. A host hosting-owner 62pt readback alone
// is not proof that the guest UIKit root received a safe content region.
readBack() // Reconcile a receipt sent before the listener attached.
guard let token = row["receipt"] as? String,
let result = row["result"] as? String else { continue }
// R6P15: the host alone knows the normal-window island inset before
// remote LiveProcess UIKit starts. Share only this anonymous geometry
// as a fallback for the guest's OWN root-controller safe-area check.
// Never publish the transient viewport zero or an overlay window.
# R6P15: only at the guest's own UIKit root, not host FBScene geometry.
// R6P15: reconcile the real guest UIWindow root safe area after attachment.
// No global UIKit hook, UIApplication.sharedApplication, scene/frame transform,
// bundle rewrite, display-scale adjustment, or per-app exceptions.
// Host safe-top fallback is anonymous normal UIWindow geometry; the
// correction itself is applied inside the real guest UI root.
// Only the missing amount is added; UIKit updates its layout guide,
// never the view's pixel frame or the guest app's drawing scale.
CGFloat deficit = MIN(130, MAX(0, target - before));
// The resident opt-in bit is supplied before LC guest bootstrap; all
// classic LC, embedded SideStore, and unrelated extensions remain inert.
"""R6P15: guest-owned top safe area and bounded saved-pairing reconnect."""
self.assertIn("CGFloat deficit = MIN(130, MAX(0, target - before));", GUEST)

entries.hypothesis: R6P16 iPhone log has 2 guest LiveProcess launches and SDK decision traces, yet zero guest_root_safearea_receipt. In original pinned LiveProcess/main.m the resident bit is set in NSUserDefaults.standardUserDefaults before LiveContainerMain; NUDGuestHooksInit in pinned Tweaks/NSUserDefaults.m replaces this default object with per-guest defaults before the Island guard initializer. R6P15 incorrectly checked the replaced object, so guard can silently skip all UIWindow observer installation despite host 62pt safe area.
entries.action: Use the original LC NSUserDefaults.lcUserDefaults retained by LiveContainerMain to read Scarlet.ResidentSDKContract.V1 inside R6P15 existing guard; do not change the root additionalSafeAreaInsets, screen geometry, per-app policies, XPC order or animation. Emit guest_root_guard_armed through existing app-group PID-scoped guest receipt channel before registering original window observers, to distinguish successful initialization from actual root correction. Add 5 activation/storage-domain tests and preserve the complete per-commit/line history in L053. Add a unique R6P17 paired native build/release branch.
entries.observation: Evidence available for installed predecessor R6P16 c17b165: guest PID 4364/4370, host safe-top 62pt, dynamic-island controls user-reported clipped; no guest_root_safearea_receipt despite remote surfaces. Pinned upstream source confirms NSUserDefaults object reassignment. 508 local Python source regressions PASS including 5 new R6P17 cases. Actual R6P17 native CI and iPhone guest_root_guard_armed, guest_root_corrected, visual/touch still pending.
evidence: 2026-11-12 R6P16 iPhone diagnostic SourceCommit=c17b16519c2b, current session b7233f34, remote content process PID 4364/4370, host owner safe top=62, no guest_root_safearea_receipt in current run.

Pinned LiveContainer 9108ae624ea001f7d7696d48407f890b48fa2653 LiveProcess/main.m and LC bootstrap write resident optin to original standard defaults, then NUDGuestHooksInit replaces standard defaults with guest app domain before island initializer.

Existing R6P15 source checks NSUserDefaults.standardUserDefaults for the opt-in, so wrong defaults domain can result in early return; hypothesis grounded in source ordering, not solely from missing log.

## 8. R6P17: P15 보정기 비활성화의 독립 원인 — 원본 LC UserDefaults와 게스트 전용 UserDefaults
52건 L001~L052의 전체 내역, 게스트 2개 실행과 패널 즉시 접기를 확인하지만,
`guest_root_safearea_receipt`를 **한 번도** 포함하지 않는다. 따라서 Safe Area가
62pt라는 호스트 기록을 R6P15의 실제 게스트 루트 보정 성공으로 해석할 수 없다.
원본 LC가 기록한 플래그를 찾지 못하면 조용히 종료할 수 있다. 이 메커니즘은 이전
Safe Area/FBScene/호스트 프레임 수정과 무관한 **시작 조건·저장소 동일성** 결함이다.
**읽는 객체만** 교체한다. 나머지 화면 배율, 상단 여백 공식, root.additionalSafeAreaInsets,
다이나믹 아일랜드 회피값, 버튼, 멀티탭, 페어링, 인증서는 변경하지 않는다.
게스트 프로세스 PID별로 우선 기록되어야 한다. 이후 `guest_root_already_safe`,
시작 이벤트만으로 화면 겹침이 해결됐다고 판정할 수는 없다.
- 새 로그에서 `guest_root_guard_armed` 없이 SDK 선택 로그만 반복된다면
P17도 실패 상태로 보고 주입·빌드 연계 또는 알림 수신 경로를 별개로 조사한다.
`guard_armed`가 발생하지만 상단이 여전히 가려지면 Safe Area 값을 더 더하는
대신 실제 화면 콘텐츠와 Safe Area 무시 여부를 검증한다. 다른 앱도 동일 기준으로 검사한다.
갱신의 `installation_verified=false`는 이번 상단 문제와 독립된 미해결 결함이다.
R6P17 수정에 설치 성공/페어링 성공을 귀속시키지 않는다.

entries.repeat_policy: Do not add another Safe Area correction, root offset multiplier, scene frame transform, delayed layout, or per-app exception. First verify guest_root_guard_armed in R6P17 device export. If absent investigate build/link/injection and notification path, not reapply this defaults substitution. If present with overlapping controls investigate actual guest content geometry independently.

generated_runtime_targets.note: Generated as direct copy during upstream pinned engine integration; not directly tracked. Exact original/defaults change in tracked .m.txt and Git diff above.

entries.success_gate: R6P17 paired iOS native source compiled, unique unsigned IPA release; iPhone log shows guard armed plus at least one root readback and actual app controls/touch unobscured in portrait; verify multiple guests and landscape do not regress. CI/test alone cannot prove visual success.
entries.privacy: No Apple account, app name, guest ID, pairing file or OTP disclosed.

entries.hypothesis: R6P17 on-device with source 9ea728f and both LiveProcess PIDs 4585,4593 proves their guest UIView root Safe Area is 62pt: guest_root_guard_armed x2, guest_root_already_safe x7, guest_root_corrected x0. Previous host, UIWindow and root Safe Area or SDK rework therefore cannot be blindly repeated. Upper interactive content may use its own coordinates or ignore root safe layout. Measure actual descendant UIKit controls and scroll views in window coordinates, without touching guest geometry.
entries.action: Add read-only bounded guest process probe to existing activated IslandContentGuard only after its existing already-safe root observation; sample same resident UIWindow root once at 650ms and again 2600ms, cap 640 descendants, depth 9, classify visible controls/UIAccessibilityTraitButton and scroll views, count candidate controls crossing independently observed safe-top, and report anonymous numeric metrics through existing PID-scoped App Group notifier. Add host relay and diagnostic field whitelist so metrics cannot be silently dropped. No UI frames, safe area deltas, display scale, app-specific exceptions, or privacy-sensitive view identities changed. Add 6 source regressions and unique R6P18 paired build/unsigned release workflow.

Guest launch history A/B count=2 and panel navigation reset observed; IPA source download separately fails NSURLErrorDomain -1005, manual refresh installation_verified=false. 514 local Python unit/source tests PASS. It does not change safe inset, root view, window geometry or SDK, and only emits anonymous bounded metrics.

Fixes require matching guest-visible controls and touch evidence after a separate causal intervention.

after: 갱신의 `installation_verified=false`는 이번 상단 문제와 독립된 미해결 결함이다.
R6P17 수정에 설치 성공/페어링 성공을 귀속시키지 않는다.
## 9. R6P17 실기기 반증과 R6P18 하위 콘텐츠 좌표 진단
`guest_root_corrected`는 0회. 이 결과는 R6P17 원본 LC Defaults 플래그
수정으로 보정기가 활성화됐다는 것을 증명하지만 상단 버튼 시각·터치
해결을 증명하지 않는다. 기존 `additionalSafeAreaInsets`를 다시 더하거나
FBScene/윈도 프레임을 조정하는 반복 수정은 금지한다.
- 첫 게스트 뒤 두 번째 실행 `recent_session_registered(count=2)`와
이 오류는 P16의 `-999`(취소)와 다르며, 자동갱신도 여전히
- 새 인과 가설: **루트 Safe Area의 62pt는 실제 하위 컨트롤이 62pt
아래에 배치됐다는 증거가 아니다.** 원본 UIKit에서도 각 UIView의
제약 조건과 개별 Safe Area 반영 여부는 다르다. 따라서 R6P18은
게스트 프로세스 내부의 현재 UIKit UIWindow에서 실제 하위 UIView 중
버튼/조작 요소 후보와 UIScrollView의 윈도 좌표를 **읽기 전용**으로
측정한다. 첫 안정 레이아웃 후 650ms/2600ms 두 번, 최대 640뷰·깊이 9로
제한. 어떤 화면 크기, 인셋, UI 프레임도 변경하지 않는다.
수집은 금지한다. `unsafe_controls>0`이면 안전 영역을 실제 침범한
컨트롤 후보의 경로를 추가 검증한다. **0이어도** SwiftUI 가상 요소나
탐색 한계로 빠졌을 수 있으므로 시각 해결로 판정할 수 없다.
- R6P18은 화면 수정본이 아니라 **새 위치 계층의 원인 검증 빌드**다.
실제 해결은 로그가 보여준 하위 콘텐츠 타입과 윈도 좌표에 대응하는
독립적인 수정 및 실기기 사진/터치 검증을 거친 뒤 판정한다.

entries.privacy: No keyboard text, view names, app identity, password, OTP, screenshot or app-signing data in telemetry.

novelty.causal_difference: Earlier audio focus isolation pauses a LiveProcess AVAudioSession and scene opacity, but neither causes UIKit to resign the outgoing guest first responder; the keyboard survives across the remote scene handoff.
novelty.falsifiable_prediction: On switching from A with its keyboard shown to B, outgoing guest PID will receive guest_keyboard_dismiss_requested and a matching first responder receipt; UIKit keyboardDidHide will also be logged if the guest observes a real hide event.

new_device_evidence.observed_value: Outgoing PID6807 retained and new PID6821 started while root remained full screen; source has no outgoing endEditing and new refresh stage names are missing from host allowlist.

novelty.why_prior_fix_failed: Previous L065 placed stage-specific errors at native origin but host executor still blocks new values; audio pause in L037 only deactivates AVAudioSession and does not release UIKit keyboard focus.

novelty.falsifiable_prediction: For each sampled guest, visible_unsafe_controls + clipped_unsafe_controls must equal unsafe_controls; the analogous image counters must also sum. """R6P25: window-space unsafe y alone does not prove a drawn island overlap.
The clip-chain probe is read-only; app scale, scroll content offset, root inset,
keyboard and AVAudioSession behavior are intentionally unchanged.
"""Reference geometry contract: x1,y1,x2,y2; non-positive area is hidden."""
for a1, b1, a2, b2 in clips:
x1, y1, x2, y2 = max(x1, a1), max(y1, b1), min(x2, a2), min(y2, b2)
if x2 <= x1 or y2 <= y1:
return frame is not None and frame[1] < safe_top - 2 and frame[3] > 5
# Raw y=3 is a false island overlap when ancestor clips at y=100.

# parent starts at y=0 and content remains visible under 62pt.

gate.allow_repeat_only_if: Previously untested concrete causal variant supported by new device evidence, with an explicit prediction, reversible one-variable test, different implementation, and documented decision.
gate.success_definition: iPhone visual screenshot/recording confirms correct top controls and direct touch in portrait, landscape and home-reentry for more than one guest; CI passing alone is not success.

fields_guide.code_locations: Each code location MUST contain actual repo-relative file, exact unified-diff @@ function/line context, and before/after changed source. Empty only when source_unavailable, never fill by inference.
fields_guide.source_revisions: Original actual source-modifying commit, not just the subsequent CI release commit.
fields_guide.device_verification: Explicit visual+touch proof from real iPhone; Xcode archive and successful telemetry aren't equivalent.

generated_source_contract: When integration Python generates or changes upstream C/Objective-C/Swift, each attempt must include generated_runtime_targets with actual generated file, function, source before/after, and generator function; never call generated files tracked git patches if they are not tracked in repo.
